items.item_text: 01. How have you demonstrated sensitivity to and understanding of the diverse academic, socioeconomic, cultural, disability, geographic, gender, gender identity, and ethnic backgrounds of community college students?
02. Please describe your background and experiences that would make you an ideal candidate for the Financial Aid Technician position.
03. Share what customer service means to you. Provide a specific example of a time when you provided or was provided with amazing customer service. Why was this customer service experience amazing?
04. Walk us through your approach to de-escalating a situation involving an upset student. Explain why you would use this approach and/or why you have used this approach in past experiences.
05. Describe the role that empathy plays in customer service.

06. This is in-house-only recruitment: This position is open to internal permanent and temporary Coast Community College District (CCCD) employees to apply. External candidates are NOT eligible to apply. If you are not a current employee with CCCD, please do not apply at this time. Are you currently employed by the Coast Community College District as an active employee? Please state your current job title and EID.

07. I understand that a COMPLETE application packet is required for consideration, which includes the following: 1. A completed Coast Community College District Online Employment Application 2. Responses to supplemental questions (clear and detailed responses are required as they will be carefully evaluated to determine the most qualified candidate(s) to be invited for an interview; please do not paste your resume, or put "see resume", or "N/A" or leave blank) Options: Yes | No

08. Please confirm that all responses provided in this application are your own original work and were not generated or assisted by artificial intelligence tools or software. By answering 'Yes,' you attest to the authenticity of your responses. Options: Yes | No
